name: freeflow-docs
description: Write and edit your Freeflow Docs documents, presentations and spreadsheets in ChatGPT: the Docs editor in the sidebar, with edits from the composer.

interface.shortDescription: Documents, presentations and spreadsheets, edited by chat
interface.longDescription: Opens your Freeflow Docs documents, presentations and spreadsheets in ChatGPT's sidebar. Edit by hand in the full editor, or ask ChatGPT to rewrite a section, fix wording, add slides, fill in cells or change formatting; the file updates in place.
